title: Amazon says Q Developer agent upgraded tens of thousands of Java apps, saving 4,500 developer-years
summary: AWS reported that Amazon used the Amazon Q Developer code-transformation agent to upgrade tens of thousands of production applications from Java 8 or 11 to Java 17 with over a thousand developers, a saving it put at over 4,500 years of development work plus performance improvements worth $260 million in annual cost savings. The post describes the Q Developer agent workflow as letting developers review and iterate on the plan before the agent implements it, and says dependency migrations that take a day or more by hand were completed in minutes.
verification_note: URL fetched 2026-10-17; byline date 01 AUG 2024 confirmed. The tens-of-thousands-of-apps, Java 8/11 to 17, 4,500 developer-years, $260M annual savings and 1,000+ developers figures all appear on the page. The candidate's 79% shipped-without-changes figure is not on this page (it comes from a later Andy Jassy social post) and was dropped; plan review is stated as a general Q Developer agent feature rather than specifically for the migration.
